note: MyDesk Fusion is a partial integrated parametric design, direct modeling, CAM, and electronics implementation targeting Autodesk Fusion. FUNCTIONAL entries describe only their explicitly tested subsets and are not complete parity.

capabilities.name: Parametric history timeline and regeneration
capabilities.reference_behavior: Chronological history timeline recording sketch and 3D features with regeneration on parameter change.
capabilities.expected_output: Parametric solid body evaluated with correct volume
capabilities.performance: Instantaneous evaluation for standard part features
capabilities.differences: Rectangle sketch extrusions regenerate as valid OCCT B-rep solids with kernel-derived topology, bounds, volume, and area. General sketches, constraints, topology naming, and most Fusion features remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Direct modeling face push/pull offset
capabilities.reference_behavior: Direct manipulation of boundary faces with automatic solid boundary recalculation.
capabilities.expected_input: Target body face and normal displacement offset
capabilities.expected_output: Solid body bounds and volume updated accordingly
capabilities.differences: Planar end-face push/pull for the supported rectangular prism regenerates a valid OCCT B-rep; arbitrary face selection and general offsets remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Timeline cursor rollback and roll-forward
capabilities.reference_behavior: Dragging or setting timeline cursor rolls document state back to that point in history.
capabilities.expected_output: Evaluated document state matches chronological position

capabilities.name: Integrated CAM toolpath generation and G-code export
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate 2.5D pocketing toolpaths with feeds and speeds and export standard RS-274 G-code.
capabilities.expected_output: Verified CNC G-code program with spindle and linear feed commands
capabilities.differences: Selected-body rectangular raster paths use B-rep bounds, cutter radius, independent XY stepover and Z stepdown, and reject invalid engagement. Stock, holders, islands, collision checking, machine kinematics, and machine-ready verification remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: ECAD PCB outline and 3D enclosure integration
capabilities.reference_behavior: Define PCB board outline geometry and thickness for mechanical packaging.
capabilities.differences: Board outline and packaging dimensions verified.

capabilities.name: Native project serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and load native .myfusion documents preserving complete timeline and parameters.
capabilities.differences: Editable timeline inputs, selected CAM body, and stepdown round-trip and regenerate OCCT geometry; schema versioning, structural parsing, atomic file writes, and complete project state remain incomplete.
